\caption[Net correctness gain vs repair output tokens]{Net correctness gain vs repair output tokens. Population: FINAL[v] vs BASE (R04) and REPAIR\_CANDIDATES (C02 output tokens, diagnostic only); unit: model x variant; block: composite. Composite block; one point per (model, variant): repair output tokens of the variant's repair candidates vs net gain of Q06 correctness pass; descriptive only (no ranking, no test). Point labels (model): 1 = claude\_fable\_5; 2 = claude\_opus\_5; 3 = deepseek\_v4\_flash; 4 = deepseek\_v4\_pro; 5 = gemini\_31\_pro; 6 = gemini\_36\_flash; 7 = openai\_gpt55; 8 = openai\_gpt56\_sol; 9 = qwen36\_35b\_a3b; 10 = qwen37\_max; 11 = qwen3\_coder\_api. BL01: Includes dense\_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10. REASONING: Reasoning settings differ between models and are not equalised (see the closure disclosure register, item reasoning\_policy\_differences); some providers report no reasoning-token field. IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test\_feedback and combined\_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped\_tests\_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static\_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test\_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction. IC2: E02 is not an independent confirmation of Q06 gains: it counts build failures, and most E02 improvements are the same cells as the Q06 improvements; the held-out signal proper is the joint transition X06 (e.g. Q06 repaired but E02 still failing) and G01. IC6: static\_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static\_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.}\label{fig:study_analysis_001:F5_gain_vs_effort}
